>"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" - The old package `@feiyang666/deepseekharnessdesktop-vault` remains published for a while, but it "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"is **no longer maintained and will not receive updates** — please migrate soon.
> - The desktop clie"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"nt (`DeepSeek Harness Desktop`) supports both package names and will **auto-detect and upgrade** ins"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"talls made with the old name."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"When the DeepSeek Harness desktop client detects a plugin load failure, it may force-clear the local"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" `~/.dsh` data (chat history, workspace data, settings, credentials, plugin configs) and restore fac"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"tory defaults. `dsh-vault` continuously backs up all critical data to a **safe location outside `~/."},{"id":"p9s4","text":"dsh`**, so your data can be fully recovered even after a wipe."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"npm package: `@feiyang666/dsh-vault` (same series as the `@feiyang666/dsh-usage-plugin` usage plugin"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"m package: `@feiyang666/dsh-vault` (same series as the `@feiyang666/dsh-usage-plugin` usage plugin)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Capability | Description |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| **Settings page "Backup Manager"** | Adds a "Backup Manager" page to the Web settings: view backup"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" status and history, back up now, one-click restore by scope (All / Chat history only / Workspace se"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ttings only), delete backups (with confirmation) |
| **Automatic backup** | First backup 6s after st"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"artup + debounced backup after session writes/settings changes (2 min) + scheduled backup every 15 m"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"in |
| **Backup contents** | `sessions/` (chat history, zstd binary full copy), `storages/` (workspa"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ce data), `settings.yaml`, `.credentials.yaml`, `.anonymous-user-id`, `profiles/` configs (excluding"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" reinstallable node_modules); **if the usage plugin (dsh-usage-plugin) is installed, its usage data "},{"id":"p13s8","text":"(`usage-records.json` / `pricing.json` etc.) is included** and restored to its original directory |
"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"| **Backup location** | `~/.dsh-backups/<timestamp>/` — outside `~/.dsh`, untouched by data wipes |
"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"| **Wipe detection** | On startup, compares backup vs current session count; red alert when data is "},{"id":"p13s11","text":"suspected wiped |
| **One-click restore** | Settings page or the `backup_vault` tool restores by sco"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"pe (All / chat history only / workspace settings only) |
| **Restore script** | Generates `restore-l"},{"id":"p13s13","text":"atest.ps1`; after quitting the desktop app, right-click to run and restore offline |
| **Delete back"},{"id":"p13s14","text":"ups** | Delete a specific backup by name from the settings page (with confirmation) |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Recommended Installation"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> Either method works and is equivalent. **We recommend the desktop app** — fully graphical, no comm"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"works and is equivalent. **We recommend the desktop app** — fully graphical, no command line needed."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Option 1 (recommended): One-click via the desktop app"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Install DeepSeek Harness Desktop, open it, then go to **"Install Plugins" → Recommended → Data Vault"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" → Install** and click **"Restart Service Now"** to activate."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Option 2: Command line"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"This plugin is a standard Cordis bundle plugin installed via npm and mounted into a dsh profile:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Or manually edit `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` and add `"@feiyang666/dsh-vault"` to `dsh.profil"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" edit `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` and add `"@feiyang666/dsh-vault"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Usage 1: Settings page "Backup Manager" (Web)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"After installing and restarting, open Settings → "Backup Manager":"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Top shows backup directory, last backup time, backup count, and data-integrity status
- "Back Up N"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ow" button triggers a manual backup
- The "Backup History" list offers "Restore" (scope: All / chat "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"history only / workspace settings only) and "Delete" (with confirmation) per item"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Usage 2: `backup_vault` tool (TUI / Web universal)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The plugin registers the `backup_vault` model tool — just tell the assistant "back me up / check bac"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"kup status / restore chat history from the latest backup / delete that old backup":"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- `action: status` — backup directory, last backup, backup list, whether a wipe was detected
- `acti"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"on: backup` — back up now
- `action: list` — list all backups
- `action: restore` (`name` + `scope`:"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" all/sessions/data) — restore
- `action: delete` (`name`) — delete a backup
- `action: make_script` "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"— generate a one-click restore script"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Manual restore (after quitting the desktop app)"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"1. Find the backup directory `~/.dsh-backups/`
2. If `restore-latest.ps1` was generated, quit the de"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"sktop app and right-click → "Run with PowerShell"
3. Or manually copy the contents of `backup-<times"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"tamp>/` back into `~/.dsh/`"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Safety notes"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Backups include `.credentials.yaml` (API keys) — keep the backup directory safe (you may copy it t"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"o an encrypted disk / cloud drive).
- Restore overwrites current data — confirm the backup time poin"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"t first.
- Chat-history files may be locked while DSH is running; it's best to quit the desktop app "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"before restoring chat history."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Related Projects"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Project | Description | Installation |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
